## Declarations and implementations

```plato

    // Apply the transform: scale, rotate, then translate.
    Transform(p: Point3D, t: TrsTransform3D): Point3D
        => ((p.PositionVector * t.Scale).Transform(t.Rotation) + t.Translation).ToPoint;

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): t * p.
    Multiply(t: TrsTransform3D, p: Point3D): Point3D
        => Transform(p, t);

    // Apply the scale and rotation to a displacement.
    Transform(v: Vector3D, t: TrsTransform3D): Vector3D
        => (v * t.Scale).Transform(t.Rotation);

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): t * v.
    Multiply(t: TrsTransform3D, v: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => Transform(v, t);

    // The homogeneous matrix of the transform: S * R * T in row-vector order.
    Matrix4x4(t: TrsTransform3D): Matrix4x4
        => Matrix4x4.CreateScale(t.Scale) * t.Rotation.Matrix4x4
            * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(t.Translation);

    // Compose through the matrix product, then re-decompose into TRS.
    // Precondition: the product is a scale-rotate-translate composition
    // (Decompose succeeds); shear is not representable as TrsTransform3D.
    Compose(first: TrsTransform3D, second: TrsTransform3D): TrsTransform3D
        => TrsTransform3D(first.Matrix4x4 * second.Matrix4x4);

    // Alias for Compose, enabling the * operator: a * b applies a first.
    Multiply(a: TrsTransform3D, b: TrsTransform3D): TrsTransform3D
        => a.Compose(b);

    // The TRS decomposition of a matrix. Precondition: the matrix is a
    // scale-rotate-translate composition (Decompose succeeds); shear and
    // projection are not representable.
    TrsTransform3D(m: Matrix4x4): TrsTransform3D {
        var d = m.Decompose;
        return (d.X2, d.X1, d.X0);
    }

    // A rigid pose widened to a TRS transform with unit scale.
    TrsTransform3D(pose: Pose3D): TrsTransform3D
        => (pose.Position.PositionVector, pose.Orientation, Number3.One);

    // The rigid part of the transform, discarding scale. Named Pose rather
    // than Pose3D because the conversion is lossy and must stay explicit.
    Pose(t: TrsTransform3D): Pose3D
        => (t.Translation.ToPoint, t.Rotation);
}
```
